status: REVISE research framing; BLOCK corrective therapeutic claim

sources.title: Clearance of p16Ink4a-positive senescent cells delays ageing-associated disorders
sources.model: BubR1 progeroid mouse with INK-ATTAC transgene
sources.intervention: Genetically enabled inducible clearance of p16-positive cells
sources.observation: Supports contribution of a senescent population to selected pathology.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Not an approved-drug experiment or correction of checkpoint biology; primary abstract/search record only.
sources.evidence_access: Primary PubMed abstract/search excerpt; PMC full text blocked by browser challenge

sources.title: MTOR regulates the pro-tumorigenic senescence-associated secretory phenotype by promoting IL1A translation
sources.model: Human fibroblast and epithelial senescence models; no BUB1B perturbation
sources.observation: Reduced IL1A translation and SASP; Figure 6 separates secretory suppression from persistent senescence arrest.
sources.contrary_or_limit: No segregation rescue or BUB1B disease-model rescue established.
sources.evidence_access: Full primary PDF via author institution; relevant text and figure legends inspected

assay_exposure.context: Subsequent experiments; multiple exposure schedules, commonly days

sources.title: Rapamune EPAR and product information
sources.observation: EU authorization: specified renal transplantation prophylaxis and sporadic LAM; EPAR updated 2026-06-04.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Approval is not for BUB1B disease; adult transplant exposure includes co-medication context.
sources.evidence_access: Current EMA EPAR webpage and full product information PDF

human_pk.context: Adult renal transplant tablet regimen with ciclosporin, months 1-3; descriptive benchmark only

sources.title: Rapamune US prescribing information (2020 archived FDA label)
sources.observation: Approximately 92% plasma protein binding; blood/plasma ratio 36 ±18.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Archived label used for PK, not sole proof of current approval; whole blood cannot stand for unbound target-tissue concentration.

sources.title: Metformin hydrochloride tablet US DailyMed label
sources.model: Official US prescription label, ANDA marketing status
sources.observation: Type 2 diabetes glycemic-control indication in adults and children age 10+; usual steady-state plasma <1 microgram/mL; negligible protein binding.
sources.contrary_or_limit: No BUB1B indication. Not a tissue concentration or universal exposure ceiling.
sources.evidence_access: Full DailyMed label, updated 2025-07-01; sections 1 and 12.3 inspected

human_pk.calculation_assumption: 1 mg/L /129.16 g/mol, assuming analyte mass is metformin free base

sources.title: Metformin inhibits the senescence-associated secretory phenotype by interfering with IKK/NF-kappaB activation
sources.model: RAS-induced IMR90 human fibroblast senescence; additional macrophage/MEF experiments
sources.observation: Figure 2 cytokine transcript suppression at 1, 2.5 and 5 mM, with proliferation-marker control.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Nominal millimolar exposure does not bridge to usual human plasma; not BUB1B rescue.
sources.evidence_access: Full primary PDF at author institution, Figure 2 and methods inspected

sources.title: Metformin improves healthspan and lifespan in mice
sources.model: Male C57BL/6 and B6C3F1 mice, not BubR1 deficiency
sources.observation: Lower exposure extended mean lifespan in C57BL/6; measured serum 0.45 ±0.09 mM. Higher exposure shortened mean lifespan.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Species/exposure mismatch; 5.03 ±0.87 mM serum at toxic higher intervention. Liver nmol/mg protein is not plasma molarity.

sources.title: SPRYCEL US prescribing information
sources.observation: Approved specified Ph+ CML/ALL uses; plasma Cmax 82.2 ng/mL; 96% plasma binding; half-life 3-5 hours.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Cancer approval does not validate senolysis. Serious hematologic, pulmonary and developmental liabilities; free estimate extrapolates binding measured at 100-500 ng/mL.
sources.evidence_access: Full current manufacturer US prescribing information including FDA-approved labeling

human_pk.context: Adult labeled clinical regimen, descriptive reference only
human_pk.free_estimate_assumptions: Constant 96% binding; not a measured free plasma or tissue value

sources.title: The Achilles’ heel of senescent cells: from transcriptome to senolytic drugs
sources.model: Human senescent preadipocytes/endothelial cells; aged, irradiated and Ercc1 progeroid mice
sources.intervention: Dasatinib alone in selected cell assays; dasatinib plus quercetin for broad in-vivo findings
sources.observation: At least 50 nM dasatinib reduced senescent preadipocyte viability over 3 days; cell-type-dependent response.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Not BubR1 model; killing rather than segregation correction; combination results cannot be assigned to monotherapy.
sources.evidence_access: Full primary Wiley article, results and figure material inspected

sources.title: Small-molecule inhibition of aging-associated chromosomal instability delays cellular senescence
sources.model: Aged human dermal fibroblasts; HT-1080 cancer-cell comparison
sources.contrary_or_limit: Higher than 0.1 micromolar could fail or worsen CIN in cancer cells; no verified market approval; not BUB1B rescue.
sources.evidence_access: Full primary PMC article and figure legends
